title: SB611 (2024 Regular): Frederick and Washington Counties – Bow Hunting – Openly Carrying Handguns

provenance.fetched_by: Open States bulk data (Maryland) (gun-policy Stage 5, Maryland); operative text read by a Sonnet fill agent from the official Mississippi text (First Reader; official copy, https://mgaleg.maryland.gov/2024RS/bills/sb/sb0611f.pdf)
provenance.note: First reader (as filed). Quote joins the existing text with the added words; the printed bracket '[deer]' was deleted, so the 'Region A' item reads 'DEER management Region A' as added in capitals. Hunting rules are the Department's own subject, not a separate topic.

operative_text: Section 1 (Md. Code Ann., Natural Resources § 10-408(b)(2)): (2) The Department may not prohibit a licensed bow hunter from openly carrying a handgun that the hunter is otherwise authorized to carry under § 4–203 of the Criminal Law Article if the bow hunter: (i) Is at least 21 years old; (ii) Is hunting in DEER management Region A as defined by the Department’s Guide to Hunting and Trapping; OR FREDERICK COUNTY OR WASHINGTON COUNTY DURING DEER HUNTING SEASON; (iii) Is carrying the handgun for personal protection; and (iv) Does not use the handgun to kill wildlife wounded by a vertical bow or crossbow.
